response.sql: WITH color_totals AS (SELECT p.product_color AS color, SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) AS invoiced FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), stats AS (SELECT color, invoiced, invoiced * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(invoiced) FROM color_totals) AS share, (SELECT AVG(invoiced) FROM color_totals) AS avg_invoiced FROM color_totals) SELECT AVG(invoiced) AS avg_invoiced_amount, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(invoiced - avg_invoiced) AS avg_above_per_color_average FROM stats WHERE invoiced > avg_invoiced
